_meta.note: 一个任务一个文件。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Enzan's Brother#000.src: Welcome to the V.S.S. Seaskipper, from Seasail Enterprises! There's nothin' better than Seasail if you're lookin' to travel!

Enzan's Brother#001.src: Just hop on the boat and buy a pass so you can get goin' to almost anywhere on the ocean!

Enzan's Brother#002.src: Talk to Enzan close to the exit of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Enzan's Brother#002.dst: 与 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 靠近 {p} 出口的 Enzan 对话。

Enzan's Brother#003.src: I see you want to venture into the wilderness!
Enzan's Brother#003.dst: 看来你想去荒野闯一闯！
Enzan's Brother#003.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#004.src: My name is Enzan, and I am now a retired knight. I've spent most of my life fighting for {p}'s army, just like you.
Enzan's Brother#004.dst: 我叫 Enzan，现在是个退役骑士。我这辈子大部分时间都在为 {p} 的军队作战，就跟你一样。
Enzan's Brother#004.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#005.src: I know how hard it must be to be a recruit at this time, so I've got something that could help you! Well, I don't have it, but my brother does!
Enzan's Brother#005.dst: 我知道这个时候当新兵有多辛苦，所以我有样东西能帮到你！嗯，东西不在我这儿，在我兄弟那儿！
Enzan's Brother#005.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#006.src: Follow this road, he's just past the item identifier, you can't miss him. Just head to the big set of stairs, past the item identifier.
Enzan's Brother#006.dst: 沿着这条路走，他就在物品鉴定师过去一点，你不会错过的。往那段大楼梯走，过了物品鉴定师就是。
Enzan's Brother#006.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#007.src: Tell him I sent you! He can be such a jerk to strangers sometimes, especially when he's focused on his stairs...
Enzan's Brother#007.dst: 告诉他是我叫你去的！他有时候对陌生人很不客气，尤其是在专心研究他的楼梯的时候……
Enzan's Brother#007.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#008.src: Find Enzan's brother near the Item Identifier on the {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Enzan's Brother#008.dst: 在 {p} [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的物品鉴定师附近找到 Enzan 的兄弟。

Enzan's Brother#009.src: Excuse me? Can't you see I'm busy?
Enzan's Brother#009.dst: 干什么？没看到我很忙吗？
Enzan's Brother#009.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#010.src: Oh, my brother? Sorry, I didn't know.
Enzan's Brother#010.dst: 噢，我兄弟叫你来的？抱歉，我不知道。
Enzan's Brother#010.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#011.src: Why yes, I actually have something that could help you...
Enzan's Brother#011.dst: 是啊，我确实有样东西能帮到你……
Enzan's Brother#011.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#012.src: But before I give it to you, why don't you help me with something first?
Enzan's Brother#012.dst: 不过给你之前，你何不先帮我一个忙？
Enzan's Brother#012.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#013.src: You see, there's a special kind of mushroom that grows in this cave. I hear it has certain... energizing properties.
Enzan's Brother#013.dst: 你看，这个洞窟里长着一种特别的蘑菇。听说它有某种……提神的功效。
Enzan's Brother#013.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#014.src: If you can bring me [{~} Energy Mushroom], I'll help you out. Enter the cave down the stairs, and bring me that mushroom!
Enzan's Brother#014.dst: 如果你能给我带来 [{~} 能量蘑菇]，我就帮你。从楼梯下去进入洞窟，把那个蘑菇带给我！
Enzan's Brother#014.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#015.src: Descend into the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring [{~} Energy Mushroom] to Therck
Enzan's Brother#015.dst: 下到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的洞窟，把 [{~} 能量蘑菇] 带给 Therck

Enzan's Brother#016.src: Ah, you're back! Do you have the mushroom?
Enzan's Brother#016.dst: 啊，你回来了！蘑菇拿到了吗？
Enzan's Brother#016.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#017.src: Take this ring. It's an accessory item! You can identify it at the nearby Item Identifier.
Enzan's Brother#017.dst: 拿着这枚戒指。这是饰品！你可以在附近的物品鉴定师那里鉴定它。
Enzan's Brother#017.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#018.src: It's a very good ring for someone starting out like you. There's just one small issue...
Enzan's Brother#018.dst: 对你这样刚起步的人来说，这是枚很好的戒指。只是有个小问题……
Enzan's Brother#018.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#019.src: To wear it, you must help my friend back in {p}. He's been pestering me for days about needing help.
Enzan's Brother#019.dst: 要戴上它，你得去帮我在 {p} 的朋友。他已经缠着我好几天说需要帮忙了。
Enzan's Brother#019.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#020.src: You should meet me there once you've gotten a little stronger. Well, see you around, {u} .

Enzan's Brother#021.src: Ah, you're back. Do you have the mushroom?

Enzan's Brother#022.src: Excellent... Now I might finally be able to climb these stairs...

Enzan's Brother#023.src: Who knows, maybe there's a treasure or something up there?

Enzan's Brother#024.src: Take this ring. It's an accessory item. You can identify it at the nearby Item Identifier.
